info.title: ReceiptRail — x402 Delivery Receipts on Solana
info.description: After an x402 settlement, anchor a SHA-256 digest of the delivered content plus the settlement reference into a Solana PDA. Buyer agents verify proof of delivery offline, forever, with zero trust in the seller. Don't hand-roll verification logic — one MCP call returns a chain-anchored receipt.
info.x-guidance: Free endpoints: GET /v1/receipt/{id} (lookup by receipt_id, payment signature, or x402_payment_ref — payment_ref always resolves on-chain) and GET /v1/health. Paid endpoint: POST /v1/receipt anchors a delivery receipt on Solana for 0.001 USDC via x402; poll the GET endpoint until outcome === settled. Founding sellers (first 10) free for 30 days. Program ID 8ACN1KNEFXM2N2FMzxTfAzB1c3g5n47ZuhbPoUXPnCTp.

post.description: Anchor a SHA-256 digest of delivered content plus the x402 settlement reference on Solana. Without a payment signature, returns 402 with an x402 v2 challenge (0.001 USDC). With a valid signature, verifies the payment and submits the receipt anchor transaction; returns 202 pending, poll GET /v1/receipt/{receipt_id} until outcome === settled.

deliverable_digest.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the delivered content (64 chars)

200.description: Receipt already existed for this payment signature (idempotent)

202.description: Receipt registered, anchor transaction submitted (outcome=pending, poll until settled)

402.description: Payment required — x402 v2 challenge with accepts[] (0.001 USDC, Solana devnet)

get.summary: Get or verify a delivery receipt
get.description: Fetch full receipt details by receipt_id, payment signature, or x402_payment_ref (payment_ref always resolves on-chain). Read-only, no cost.

200.description: Receipt details (outcome settled/pending/failed, digests, checks, PDA)

none.description: No auth for free endpoints; paid endpoint uses x402 payment signature header instead of bearer tokens
